The '''New Generation Project''' was a scientific research endeavor funded by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans. The project's aim was to create [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Mandalorian knights to rival the [[Jedi/Legends|warriors]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The Project was headed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Demagol|Antos Wyrick]], but ended in failure when the [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] organization known as [[The Crucible]] invaded the [[New Generation Academy]] and kidnapped all of Wyrick's child test subjects.

==History==
To fulfill his plan and create [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] knights, Wyrick set up the [[New Generation Academy]]. Using [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] found on the robes of the deceased [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Arca Jeth]], he created several children that he would train to help him in an eventual Mandalorian revolution. [[Jarael]] was the first of these children.

The project ended when the school was raided by [[the Crucible]], a massive slaving organization. The children were captured and held on [[Osadia]] by their captors. Jarael became a Crucible minder before eventually escaping.

Years later, Wyrick found Jarael and planned to free all his former students from the Crucible. However, [[Chantique]], Wyrick's daughter and one of the Crucible leaders, had killed the students and buried them in the yard. Furious, Wyrick killed her but died himself in the process, destroying his dreams of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Mandalorian warriors.

It was also revealed that the project had never worked and that all the children had never inherited the strong Force sensitivity of Arca Jeth that Wyrick wanted them to gain. Chantique's Force powers stemmed from Wyrick's own Force sensitivity that he had never figured out.
